_comment_1: Android Firebase config. Copy to google-services.json in this same folder, then fill in the five <FILL_IN> values from the Firebase console: Project settings > General > Your apps > Android app. google-services.json is gitignored.
_comment_2: Leaving this file as .example is fine: mobile/android/app/build.gradle.kts only applies the google-services plugin when a real google-services.json is present, so the app still builds and runs in offline mode without it.
_comment_3: package_name must stay com.runiac.runiac_app — it has to match applicationId in build.gradle.kts, so register the Android app in Firebase under exactly that id.
